gist.summary: Agent API responses now include `model`, the exact `community/<GitHub username>/<agent name>` string to pass when calling an agent. It is `null` for older agents whose owners have not linked GitHub. `polli-cli agents` displays the callable model name in its table, and `agents create` prints it after creation. The CLI also explains that a new agent may take a minute or two to appear in the model catalog, that `agents sync` does not speed this up, and that owners of older agents can link GitHub to get a callable model name.
